name: hcapp_setBulkEventAttendence
description: Sets attendance state for multiple hashers at a single event. Accepts a comma-separated list of hasher UUIDs, parses via STRING_SPLIT+TRY_CAST, updates existing HasherEventMap rows (AttendenceState + RsvpState=3) and inserts new rows for hashers not yet at the event. Only attendance states 20–40 (on trail or on inn) are accepted — bulk un-attend is not supported. After the write, recalculates run counts for all affected users via HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers, returns a summary rowset, then delegates to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to return current event admin sync data.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated against the device secret.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event to update attendance for. Validated as non-null and non-zero.

parameters.name: hasherIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of hasher UUID strings. Parsed via STRING_SPLIT+TRY_CAST; invalid UUIDs are silently skipped. Validated as non-null.

parameters.name: attendenceState
parameters.description: Attendance state to apply to all listed hashers. Must be in range 20–40 inclusive. Values below 20 (un-attend) are rejected.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. NULLs are coerced to 'ignore' before delegation.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Sync watermark passed to hcapp_syncEventAdminData. NULLs are coerced to 'ignore' before delegation.

rowsets.name: WriteEnvelope
rowsets.description: Standard HC6 write envelope. Always returned as the first rowset. success=0 on any auth or validation failure; success=1 on commit. errorCode and errorType are NULL on success.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Application error code, or NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code, or NULL on success.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 only on failure (auth or validation). Contains one row with structured error detail for the caller.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Name of the SP that produced the error.

rowsets.name: BulkAttendanceResult
rowsets.description: Returned as rowset 1 only on success. Single row summarising how many HEM rows were updated vs inserted.

columns.name: serverMessage
columns.description: Human-readable summary: 'N records updated, M records inserted'.

rowsets.name: SyncEventAdminData (delegated)
rowsets.description: Rowsets 2+ are the full response from HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — event details, hasher list, HasherEventMap rows, HasherKennelMap rows, payments, kennel credits, receipts. See that SP's contract for column definitions. Only present on success.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherEventMap SET AttendenceState=@attendenceState, RsvpState=3, updatedAt=GETDATE() — for each parsed hasher UUID that already has a HEM row for the event
INSERT HC.HasherEventMap — for each parsed hasher UUID not yet in the event (IsHare=0, VirginVisitorType=0, RsvpState=3)
EXEC HC.nonApi_updateRunCountsForAllUsers @updatedSince — called outside the transaction, after commit
EXEC HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — delegates sync data retrieval; runs outside the transaction after run counts are updated

codeSmells.detail: Run count recalculation is deliberately called after COMMIT (line 167). This avoids a long-running operation inside the transaction, but means run counts could be stale if the EXEC fails. Acceptable as a best-effort post-commit side effect, but should be noted.

codeSmells.issue: Invalid UUIDs in @hasherIds are silently skipped
codeSmells.detail: STRING_SPLIT+TRY_CAST discards any token that cannot be cast to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER without warning the caller. A malformed hasher list would partially succeed with no indication of which UUIDs were dropped.

The ParsedGuids CTE is re-declared identically for the UPDATE (line 131) and the INSERT (line 147). SQL Server does not allow sharing a CTE across statements, so this is unavoidable, but it adds noise and creates a maintenance surface — the two declarations must be kept in sync.
ErrorLog inserts use HcVersion='<unknown>' (lines 87, 99, 113, 182). Should be replaced with an actual version constant or left as NULL — '<unknown>' is a sentinel string with no diagnostic value.

breakingChanges: @hasherIds widened from VARCHAR(8000) to NVARCHAR(MAX) — callers passing exactly 8000 characters are unaffected; callers relying on implicit truncation at 8000 characters will now receive the full string
TRY/CATCH and BEGIN TRANSACTION added — the entire UPDATE+INSERT is now atomic; HC5 had no transaction so partial writes were possible
Success envelope (rowset 0: success, errorCode, errorType) added as the new first rowset — HC5 had no envelope; all HC5 rowset indices shift up by one
Delegation target updated from HC5.hcapp_syncEventAdminData to HC6.hcapp_syncEventAdminData — sync rowset columns may differ
serverMessage trailing comma removed — HC5 produced 'N records updated, M records inserted, ' (trailing comma); HC6 produces 'N records updated, M records inserted'
